name: YURIKA Audio v2.8.0 Spatial / Reflection / Multi-Tab Workstation

jiro_final_audit.note: deterministic design audit; browser endurance/listening remain empirical

limitations: Localization error is a signal-cue proxy, not psychophysical ground truth.
HRTF cue consistency is a heuristic; it is not personalized-HRTF validation.
Reflection Character does not change physical room/surface reflection coefficients.
hardwareConcurrency is a scheduling hint only; Chrome controls JIT and thread/core placement.
A/V compensation can add audio delay but cannot provide negative delay when DSP audio already lags video.
Concurrent tabs share one DSP parameter set in v2.8.
